Bank of Maharashtra Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Full Details

Bank Of Maharashtra has released the notification for the post of Apprentice. This recruitment has been issued for 600 posts. Online applying process for Bank of Maharashtra Apprentice Recruitment 2026 has started from 15 January 2026 & the candidates can apply till 25 January 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Bank of Maharashtra Apprentice Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 January 2026
  • Last Date : 25 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 January 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 150/- + GST
  • SC, ST : Rs. 100/- + GST

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Bank of Maharashtra Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.
